description: Create an Airflow DAG for travel_booking that extracts reservations from a rate-limited partner API and loads them into Snowflake. The DAG should: (1) extract pages of reservations with a TaskFlow task that retries up to 5 times with exponential backoff capped at 30 minutes, (2) distinguish retryable errors (HTTP 429, 5xx, timeouts) from non-retryable errors (401, 403, 400) and raise AirflowFailException for the latter, (3) write the extracted pages to a stage path keyed by run_id and try_number-independent filenames, (4) COPY into Snowflake, (5) on final failure invoke an on_failure_callback that posts to the incident channel.
edge_cases: A retry after a partial extract must overwrite the stage files, not add a second set with a different name
401/403 must fail immediately without consuming retries
on_failure_callback fires only after retries are exhausted; on_retry_callback is separate
Respect the Retry-After header on 429 when it exceeds the computed backoff
The extract window must be half-open [data_interval_start, data_interval_end)
common_failure_modes: FM6: Stage file names include try_number or a timestamp, so a retry loads both partial and complete extracts
FM6: Catching all exceptions and returning normally marks the task successful with partial data
FM2: Inclusive upper bound re-extracts boundary records in the next run
